title: Fish Speech MLX weights dropped due to missing model prefix in safetensors keys
description: Upstream mlx_audio Model.sanitize in fish_speech silently dropped weights because keys in mlx-community/fishaudio-s2-pro-8bit-mlx lack the model. prefix. This caused inference to execute with 766 uninitialized weights, producing garbled acoustic noise instead of speech. Fixed by remapping keys in _load_fish_mlx_model and validating with strict=True.
